name: Cite This Article ~ Author Box
author: writerspress

sections.description:
Cite This Article ~ Author Box adds an editorial-style author box with a built-in “Cite this article” toggle, making it easier for readers to properly reference, share, and credit your work.

Whether you run a blog, publication, research site, or editorial platform, the plugin helps turn your articles into more easily citable content by giving readers a clear citation they can copy and reuse.

The plugin generates a citation for the current article, supports multiple authors natively, includes one-click copy support, and provides a direct reformat link through CiteKit for generating additional citation styles.

When Co-Authors Plus is active, Cite This Article automatically uses every author assigned to the post. The author box can show those authors together or as individual author cards, including profile avatars and biographies where available.
Designed for bloggers, journalists, researchers, educators, and online publishers who want to strengthen content credibility, improve source transparency, and make their work easier to reference across the web.

Works as both a Gutenberg block and shortcode with identical markup and styling.

Features

  • Built-in “Cite this article” toggle.
  • Native multiple-author citation support.
  • Automatic Co-Authors Plus integration, including guest authors.
  • Standard WordPress author fallback.
  • Combined author display or individual author cards.
  • Single/group image, individual author images, or no-image display.
  • Co-Authors Plus and WordPress profile avatars used automatically in individual mode.
  • Per-author manual description overrides in the Gutenberg editor, with automatic profile bios as the fallback.
  • Manual citation-author overrides in the block and shortcode.
  • One-click copy citation support.
  • Reformat citations into other styles through CiteKit.
  • Gutenberg block + shortcode support.
  • Horizontal and vertical card orientations, round or square avatars, and small/medium/large sizing.
  • Settings page under CiteKit when available, otherwise under Tools.
  • Lightweight front-end output with no external framework dependencies.

Upgrade to Premium

A premium upgrade adds publishing-scale automation and citation portability on top of everything in the free plugin. These features are not included in this free plugin; they are unlocked by upgrading:

  • Reference-manager exports — BibTeX, RIS, and CSL-JSON download links in the citation panel.
  • Citation-aware page metadata — Google/Highwire citation_* tags so reference managers recognize your articles automatically.
  • Advanced placement and targeting — insert the box automatically by content position, CSS selector, or theme hook, with post-type, author, specific-post, and taxonomy rules.
  • Per-content-type presentation profiles for automatically placed boxes.

Author Resolution

By default, article authors are resolved in this order:

  1. Manual citation authors entered in the block or shortcode.
  2. Co-Authors Plus authors, when Co-Authors Plus is active.
  3. The standard WordPress post author.
  4. The site name as a final fallback.

The automatic author source can be changed from the Cite This Article settings page. Citation generation and author-box presentation use the same resolved author collection; the visual display name never replaces the citation author list.

Multi-Author Display

The block includes two presentation controls:

Author layout — Combined (one author group) or Individual (one card per resolved author).

Images — In Combined layout, show one selected group image (with a single-author avatar fallback) or none. In Individual layout, show each author’s own avatar (Co-Authors Plus guest-author avatars supported) or none. In Individual mode, WordPress author bios and Co-Authors Plus descriptions display automatically, with a per-author Manual Description Override field available in the editor.

Gutenberg Block

The plugin includes a dedicated Gutenberg block called “Author Box with Citation,” with controls for author layout, image mode, manual citation authors (one per line), optional Media Library image overrides in Individual mode, card orientation, avatar shape, and avatar sizing. Leave the manual citation-authors field empty to use Co-Authors Plus automatically when available, or the standard WordPress post author otherwise.

Shortcode

Two tags are registered:

  • [author_box] — friendly short tag, registered only when no other plugin has claimed it.
  • [citekit_author_box] — namespaced tag, always available.

Examples:

[author_box]

[author_box author_layout="individual" image_mode="individual"]

[author_box authors="Jane Doe|John Smith|Alex Lee" author_layout="individual" image_mode="individual"]

Accepted attributes: name, authors, tagline, description, image, image_id, author_images, author_layout (combined/individual), image_mode (single/individual/none), layout (horizontal/vertical), avatar_shape (round/square), avatar_size (sm/md/lg), and post_id.
sections.faq:
Does Cite This Article support multiple authors?

Yes. Multiple article authors are supported natively and are used together in the generated citation.

Does it work with Co-Authors Plus?

Yes. When Co-Authors Plus is active and manual citation authors have not been supplied, the plugin reads all authors assigned to the post using Co-Authors Plus. Guest authors are supported, including their avatar handling.

Can each Co-Authors Plus author have a separate author box?

Yes. Set Author layout to Individual. The plugin renders one author card for each resolved co-author while keeping one shared “Cite this article” panel containing the complete article citation.

What happens if Co-Authors Plus is not installed?

The plugin falls back to the standard WordPress post author automatically.

Does the visual Name field control the citation author?

No. The visual author-box display name is separate from the article’s citation authors.

Is it accessible?

Yes. The cite toggle uses aria-expanded and aria-controls, the copy button includes an accessible label, and the box is marked as a complementary region.

Does it load assets on every page?

No. Front-end CSS and JavaScript are registered globally but enqueued only when an author box is rendered.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • New: native multiple-author citations with automatic Co-Authors Plus integration, guest-author avatars, and guest/WordPress bios.
  • New: Combined and Individual author-box presentation modes — one card per resolved author with a shared citation panel.
  • New: image controls (single/group, individual, or none), avatar shape, and avatar size.
  • New: settings page with automatic author-source controls and integration status.
  • New: automatic author lookup in the block editor, manual multi-author entry, and shortcode attributes.
  • New: per-author manual description overrides for resolved and manual authors.

1.1.0

  • New: editorial-style monochrome design with layout, image shape, and image size controls.
  • New: shortcode attributes for layout, avatar shape, and avatar size.
  • New: image_id and post_id shortcode attributes.
  • New: friendly [author_box] shortcode tag alongside [citekit_author_box].

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
